intro.en: Two friends, Omar and Yusuf, ask each other quiz questions about the Islamic world. Notice the words 'more than' and 'the most' (أَكْثَر، أَكْبَر): they follow the pattern أَفْعَل.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Umar aur Yusuf ek doosre se Islami duniya ke baare mein sawal poochte hain. Dhyan dein: أَكْثَر aur أَكْبَر jaise alfaaz 'zyada' aur 'sab se bada' ka matlab dete hain.
intro.ar: يَتَبادَلُ عُمَرُ وَيوسُفُ أَسْئِلَةَ مُسابَقَةٍ عَنِ العالَمِ الإِسْلامِيِّ. لاحِظْ كَلِماتٍ مِثْلَ «أَكْثَر» وَ«أَكْبَر»؛ فَهِيَ عَلى وَزْنِ «أَفْعَل».

dialogue.ar: جَهَّزْتُ لَكَ مُسابَقَةً في مَعْلوماتِ العالَمِ الإِسْلامِيِّ يا يوسُف، فَهَلْ تَقْبَلُ التَّحَدّي؟
dialogue.tr: jahhaztu laka musābaqatan fī maʿlūmāti l-ʿālami l-islāmiyyi yā yūsuf, fahal taqbalu t-taḥaddī?
dialogue.en: I prepared a quiz for you on knowledge of the Islamic world, Yusuf; do you accept the challenge?
dialogue.ur: Maine aap ke liye Islami duniya ki maloomat ka musabaqa tayyar kiya hai Yusuf; kya aap chunauti qubool karte hain?

dialogue.ar: جاهِزٌ! نَتَبادَلُ الأَسْئِلَةَ، وَمَنْ أَجابَ أَكْثَرَ فازَ.
dialogue.tr: jāhiz! natabādalu l-asʾilah, waman ajāba akthara fāz.
dialogue.en: Ready! We swap questions, and whoever answers more wins.
dialogue.ur: Tayyar! Hum sawal badalte hain, aur jo zyada jawab de woh jeet jata hai.

dialogue.ar: جَيِّد. أَبْدَأُ أَنا: كَمْ يَبْلُغُ عَدَدُ المُسْلِمينَ عَلى الأَرْض؟
dialogue.tr: jayyid. abdaʾu anā: kam yablughu ʿadadu l-muslimīna ʿalā l-arḍ?
dialogue.en: Good. I start: how many Muslims are there on earth?
dialogue.ur: Theek hai. Main shuru karta hoon: zameen par kitne Musalman hain?

dialogue.ar: الجَوابُ: يَزيدُ عَدَدُهُمْ عَلى مِلْيار.
dialogue.tr: al-jawāb: yazīdu ʿadaduhum ʿalā milyār.
dialogue.en: The answer: their number is more than a billion.
dialogue.ur: Jawab: un ki tadad ek arab se zyada hai.

dialogue.ar: سُؤالي أَنا: أَيُّ قارَّةٍ فيها أَكْبَرُ عَدَدٍ مِنَ المُسْلِمينَ؟
dialogue.tr: suʾālī anā: ayyu qārratin fīhā akbaru ʿadadin mina l-muslimīn?
dialogue.en: My question: which continent has the largest number of Muslims?
dialogue.ur: Mera sawal: kis barr-e-azam mein Musalmanon ki sab se bari tadad hai?

dialogue.ar: الجَوابُ: آسيا. وَسُؤالي: أَيُّ قارَّةٍ فيها أَكْثَرُ الدُّوَلِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ؟
dialogue.tr: al-jawāb: ʾāsī. wasuʾālī: ayyu qārratin fīhā aktharu d-duwali l-islāmiyyah?
dialogue.en: The answer: Asia. And my question: which continent has the most Islamic countries?
dialogue.ur: Jawab: Asia. Aur mera sawal: kis barr-e-azam mein sab se zyada Islami mulk hain?

dialogue.ar: الجَوابُ: إِفْريقيا. وَالآنَ: أَيَّةُ دَوْلَةٍ إِسْلامِيَّةٍ يَسْكُنُها أَكْبَرُ عَدَدٍ مِنَ النّاسِ؟
dialogue.tr: al-jawāb: ifrīqī. wālʾān: ayyatu dawlatin islāmiyyatin yaskunuhā akbaru ʿadadin mina n-nās?
dialogue.en: The answer: Africa. And now: which Islamic country has the largest number of people living in it?
dialogue.ur: Jawab: Africa. Aur ab: kaun se Islami mulk mein logon ki sab se bari tadad rehti hai?

dialogue.ar: الجَوابُ: إِنْدونيسيا. وَما أَكْبَرُ دَوْلَةٍ عَرَبِيَّةٍ مِساحَةً؟
dialogue.tr: al-jawāb: indūnīsī. wamā akbaru dawlatin ʿarabiyyatin misāḥah?
dialogue.en: The answer: Indonesia. And what is the largest Arab country by area?
dialogue.ur: Jawab: Indonesia. Aur raqbe ke lihaaz se sab se bada Arab mulk kaun sa hai?

dialogue.ar: الجَوابُ: الجَزائِر. وَأَيُّ دَوْلَةٍ إِسْلامِيَّةٍ في آسيا هِيَ الأَصْغَرُ مِساحَةً؟
dialogue.tr: al-jawāb: al-jazāʾir. waʾayyu dawlatin islāmiyyatin fī ʾāsī hiya l-aṣgharu misāḥah?
dialogue.en: The answer: Algeria. And which Islamic country in Asia is the smallest in area?
dialogue.ur: Jawab: Algeria. Aur Asia ka kaun sa Islami mulk raqbe mein sab se chhota hai?

dialogue.ar: الجَوابُ: جُزُرُ المالْديف. كَمْ بَقِيَ مِنَ الأَسْئِلَةِ؟
dialogue.tr: al-jawāb: juzuru l-māldīf. kam baqiya mina l-asʾilah?
dialogue.en: The answer: the Maldives. How many questions are left?
dialogue.ur: Jawab: Maldives. Kitne sawal baqi hain?

dialogue.ar: بَقِيَ لِكُلٍّ مِنّا سُؤالٌ واحِد.
dialogue.tr: baqiya likullin minnā suʾālun wāḥid.
dialogue.en: One question is left for each of us.
dialogue.ur: Hum mein se har ek ka ek sawal baqi hai.

dialogue.ar: ما أَكْبَرُ دَوْلَةٍ في الجَزيرَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ مِساحَةً؟
dialogue.tr: mā akbaru dawlatin fī l-jazīrati l-ʿarabiyyati misāḥah?
dialogue.en: What is the largest country in the Arabian Peninsula by area?
dialogue.ur: Jazeera-numa-e-Arab ka raqbe mein sab se bada mulk kaun sa hai?

dialogue.ar: الجَوابُ: السُّعودِيَّة. وَالآنَ كَمْ نُقْطَةً جَمَعْتَ؟
dialogue.tr: al-jawāb: as-suʿūdiyyah. wālʾāna kam nuqṭatan jamaʿt?
dialogue.en: The answer: Saudi Arabia. Now, how many points did you collect?
dialogue.ur: Jawab: Saudi Arabia. Ab batayein aap ne kitne points jama kiye?

dialogue.ar: جَمَعْتُ سِتَّ نِقاطٍ، وَأَنْتَ جَمَعْتَ خَمْسَ نِقاط.
dialogue.tr: jamaʿtu sitta niqāṭ, waʾanta jamaʿta khamsa niqāṭ.
dialogue.en: I collected six points, and you collected five points.
dialogue.ur: Maine chhe points jama kiye, aur aap ne paanch.

dialogue.ar: تَهانينا يا عُمَر، فَقَدْ تَعَلَّمْنا الكَثيرَ مِنْ هذِهِ المُسابَقَة.
dialogue.tr: tahānīnā yā ʿumar, faqad taʿallamnā l-kathīra min hādhihi l-musābaqah.
dialogue.en: Congratulations, Omar; we learned a lot from this quiz.
dialogue.ur: Mubarak ho Umar; hum ne is musabaqe se bohat kuch seekha.

q.en: According to the quiz, which Islamic country has the most inhabitants?
q.ur: Musabaqe ke mutabiq kaun se Islami mulk mein sab se zyada log rehte hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ دَوْلَةٍ إِسْلامِيَّةٍ فيها أَكْبَرُ عَدَدٍ مِنَ السُّكّانِ حَسَبَ المُسابَقَةِ؟

q.en: Which continent has the most Muslims?
q.ur: Kis barr-e-azam mein sab se zyada Musalman hain?

q.en: Which continent has the largest number of Islamic countries?
q.ur: Kis barr-e-azam mein sab se zyada Islami mulk hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ قارَّةٍ فيها أَكْبَرُ عَدَدٍ مِنَ الدُّوَلِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ؟

q.en: What does أَصْغَر mean?
q.ur: أَصْغَر ka matlab kya hai?

title.ur: Mutazaad alfaaz aur do ek jaisi awazen

intro.en: Learn pairs of opposite words (أَكْبَر / أَصْغَر) and the rule of two identical letters meeting. When the first is sukoon and the second follows, they merge and are read as one letter with shaddah, like قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ read as 'qālat-tāʾifah'.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein hum mutazaad (ulte) alfaaz seekhenge, jaise أَكْبَر / أَصْغَر. Phir qaida: agar do ek jaise harf milen aur pehla saakin ho, to dono mil kar ek mushaddad harf ki tarah parhe jaate hain, jaise قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ.
intro.ar: تَعَلَّمْ أَزْواجاً مِنَ الكَلِماتِ المُتَضادَّةِ مِثْلَ أَكْبَر وَأَصْغَر، وَقاعِدَةَ التِقاءِ حَرْفَيْنِ مُتَماثِلَيْنِ: إِذا سَكَنَ الأَوَّلُ يُدْغَمانِ وَيُقْرَآنِ حَرْفاً واحِداً مُشَدَّداً، مِثْلَ «قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ».

q.en: What is the opposite of أَكْبَر (bigger)?
q.ur: أَكْبَر ka ulta kya hai?

q.en: What is the opposite of أَغْنَى (richer)?
q.ur: أَغْنَى ka ulta kya hai?

q.en: What is the opposite of أَقْرَب (nearer)?
q.ur: أَقْرَب ka ulta kya hai?

q.en: In قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ the letters ت and ط are read as one letter with a...
q.ur: قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ mein ت aur ط ek harf ki tarah parhe jaate hain, jis par hota hai...
q.ar: في «قالَتْ طائِفَةٌ» يُقْرَأُ حَرْفا التّاءِ وَالطّاءِ حَرْفاً واحِداً مَعَ...

intro.en: An adverb of place is a mansūb noun that tells where an action happens, for example فَوْقَ (above) and تَحْتَ (below). Example: الطَّيْرُ فَوْقَ الشَّجَرَةِ, 'The bird is above the tree'.
intro.ur: ظَرْفُ المَكان woh ism hai jo mansoob hota hai aur batata hai ke kaam kis jagah hua, jaise فَوْقَ (upar) aur تَحْتَ (neeche). Misaal: الطَّيْرُ فَوْقَ الشَّجَرَةِ, yaani 'parinda darakht ke upar hai'.
intro.ar: ظَرْفُ المَكانِ اِسْمٌ مَنْصوبٌ يَدُلُّ عَلى مَكانِ حُدوثِ الفِعْلِ، مِثْلَ «فَوْقَ» وَ«تَحْتَ». مِثالٌ: الطَّيْرُ فَوْقَ الشَّجَرَةِ.

dialogue.ar: تَقَعُ مِصْرُ شَمالَ السُّودانِ.
dialogue.tr: taqaʿu miṣru shamāla s-sūdān.
dialogue.en: Egypt lies north of Sudan.
dialogue.ur: Misr, Sudan ke shimal mein waqe hai.

dialogue.ar: يَقِفُ الطُّلّابُ أَمامَ المُعَلِّمِ، وَالمُديرُ وَراءَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: yaqifu ṭ-ṭullābu amāma l-muʿallim, wālmudīru warāʾahum.
dialogue.en: The students stand in front of the teacher, and the principal is behind them.
dialogue.ur: Talaba ustaad ke samne khade hain, aur principal un ke peeche hai.

dialogue.ar: جَلَسَ الوَلَدُ بَيْنَ أَبيهِ وَأَخيهِ.
dialogue.tr: jalasa l-waladu bayna abīhi waʾakhīh.
dialogue.en: The boy sat between his father and his brother.
dialogue.ur: Larka apne walid aur apne bhai ke darmiyan baitha.

dialogue.ar: الطَّيْرُ فَوْقَ الشَّجَرَةِ.
dialogue.tr: aṭ-ṭayru fawqa sh-shajarah.
dialogue.en: The bird is above the tree.
dialogue.ur: Parinda darakht ke upar hai.

dialogue.ar: الحَقيبَةُ تَحْتَ الطّاوِلَةِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥaqībatu taḥta ṭ-ṭāwilah.
dialogue.en: The bag is under the table.
dialogue.ur: Bag mez ke neeche hai.

dialogue.ar: صَلَّيْتُ خَلْفَ الإِمامِ في الصَّفِّ الأَوَّلِ.
dialogue.tr: ṣallaytu khalfa l-imāmi fī ṣ-ṣaffi l-awwal.
dialogue.en: I prayed behind the imam in the first row.
dialogue.ur: Maine pehli saf mein imam ke peeche namaz parhi.

dialogue.ar: وَقَفَ الحارِسُ عِنْدَ البَوّابَةِ.
dialogue.tr: waqafa l-ḥārisu ʿinda l-bawwābah.
dialogue.en: The guard stood at the gate.
dialogue.ur: Pehredaar darwaze ke paas khada raha.

dialogue.ar: المَسْجِدُ يَمينَ المَدْرَسَةِ، وَالحَديقَةُ يَسارَها.
dialogue.tr: al-masjidu yamīna l-madrasah, wālḥadīqatu yasārahā.
dialogue.en: The mosque is to the right of the school, and the garden to its left.
dialogue.ur: Masjid school ke daayein taraf hai, aur bagh uske baayein taraf.

q.en: What does فَوْقَ mean?
q.ur: فَوْقَ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means 'between'?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz 'beech mein' ka matlab rakhta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى الوَسَطِ بَيْنَ شَيْئَيْنِ؟

q.en: Complete: الحَقيبَةُ ___ الطّاوِلَةِ (the bag is under the table).
q.ur: Mukammal karein: الحَقيبَةُ ___ الطّاوِلَةِ (bag mez ke neeche hai).

q.en: An adverb of place is in which case?
q.ur: ظَرْفُ المَكان kis halat mein hota hai?

title.ur: Sunna aur bolna: aap ka mulk

intro.en: In this lesson you listen to a news item about a new magazine of the Muslims-Help organisation, then practise asking a classmate about your country: its name, continent, capital, people and area.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek khabar sunni hai jo Musalmanon ki madad karne wali tanzeem aur uske naye risale ke baare mein hai. Phir apne saathi se apne mulk ke baare mein sawal jawab karne hain: naam, barr-e-azam, daar-ul-hukoomat, aabadi aur raqba.
intro.ar: في هذا الدَّرْسِ تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى خَبَرٍ عَنْ مَجَلَّةٍ جَديدَةٍ لِمُنَظَّمَةِ مُسْلِمينَ هِلْب، ثُمَّ تَسْأَلُ زَميلَكَ عَنْ بَلَدِهِ: اسْمِهِ وَقارَّتِهِ وَعاصِمَتِهِ وَسُكّانِهِ وَمِساحَتِهِ.

dialogue.ar: قُلْ لي، ما هُوَ اسْمُ وَطَنِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: qul lī, mā huwa ismu waṭanik?
dialogue.en: Tell me, what is the name of your homeland?
dialogue.ur: Mujhe batayein, aap ke watan ka naam kya hai?

dialogue.ar: أَيَّةُ قارَّةٍ يَقَعُ فيها وَطَنُكَ؟
dialogue.tr: ayyatu qārratin yaqaʿu fīhā waṭanuk?
dialogue.en: Which continent is your homeland in?
dialogue.ur: Aap ka watan kis barr-e-azam mein waqe hai?

dialogue.ar: ما عاصِمَتُهُ؟
dialogue.tr: mā ʿāṣimatuh?
dialogue.en: What is its capital?
dialogue.ur: Is ka daar-ul-hukoomat kya hai?

dialogue.ar: كَمْ يَبْلُغُ عَدَدُ سُكّانِهِ؟
dialogue.tr: kam yablughu ʿadadu sukkānih?
dialogue.en: How many inhabitants does it have?
dialogue.ur: Is ki aabadi kitni hai?

dialogue.ar: ما مِساحَتُهُ؟
dialogue.tr: mā misāḥatuh?
dialogue.en: What is its area?
dialogue.ur: Is ka raqba kitna hai?

dialogue.ar: كَمْ مُسْلِماً يَعيشُ فيهِ؟
dialogue.tr: kam musliman yaʿīshu fīh?
dialogue.en: How many Muslims live in it?
dialogue.ur: Is mein kitne Musalman rehte hain?

q.en: How do you ask 'What is its capital?'
q.ur: 'Us ka daar-ul-hukoomat kya hai?' arabi mein kaise poochte hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ نَسْأَلُ بِهِ عَنِ العاصِمَةِ؟

q.en: What does مِساحَة mean?
q.ur: مِساحَة ka matlab kya hai?

title.en: Reading: Features of the Islamic world

intro.en: A reading about how Islam began in Arabia, spread quickly, united peoples of many races and languages, and gave the Islamic world an important location. Read slowly, sentence by sentence.
intro.ur: Is parhne ke hisse mein hai ke Islam ki dawat Arab se shuru hui, tezi se phaili, mukhtalif qaumon ko ek kiya aur Islami duniya ko ahem muqaam mila. Aahista aahista jumla ba jumla parhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ: بَدَأَتْ دَعْوَةُ الإِسْلامِ في الجَزيرَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ وَاِنْتَشَرَتْ بِسُرْعَةٍ، وَجَمَعَتْ شُعوباً مِنْ أَجْناسٍ وَلُغاتٍ كَثيرَةٍ، وَأَعْطَتِ العالَمَ الإِسْلامِيَّ مَوْقِعاً مُهِمّاً. اِقْرَأْ ببُطْءٍ جُمْلَةً جُمْلَةً.

dialogue.ar: ظَهَرَ الإِسْلامُ أَوَّلاً في الجَزيرَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ، وَذلِكَ في بِدايَةِ القَرْنِ السّابِعِ لِلمِيلادِ، ثُمَّ وَصَلَ إِلى بِلادٍ بَعيدَةٍ بِسُرْعَة.
dialogue.tr: ẓahara l-islāmu awwalan fī l-jazīrati l-ʿarabiyyah, wadhlika fī bidāyati l-qarni s-sābiʿi lilmīlād, thumma waṣala ilā bilādin baʿīdatin bisurʿah.
dialogue.en: Islam first appeared in the Arabian Peninsula, at the beginning of the seventh century CE, and then reached distant lands quickly.
dialogue.ur: Islam sab se pehle Jazeera-numa-e-Arab mein zahir hua, satwin sadi eesvi ke aaghaz mein, phir tezi se door daraz mulkon tak pahunch gaya.

dialogue.ar: وَفي أَقَلَّ مِنْ مِئَةِ سَنَةٍ أَصْبَحَتْ بِلادُ المُسْلِمينَ تَشْغَلُ مِساحَةً كَبيرَةً مِنَ الكُرَةِ الأَرْضِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: wafī aqalla min miʾati sanatin aṣbaḥat bilādu l-muslimīna tashghalu misāḥatan kabīratan mina l-kurati l-arḍiyyah.
dialogue.en: In less than a hundred years the land of the Muslims came to occupy a large area of the globe.
dialogue.ur: Sau saal se kam mein Musalmanon ki sarzameen zameen ke ek bare raqbe par phail gayi.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ بَلَغَتْ حُدودُها شَرْقاً أَطْرافَ الصّينِ، وَغَرْباً شَواطِئَ المُحيطِ الأَطْلَسِيِّ، وَجَنوباً المُحيطَ الهِنْدِيَّ.
dialogue.tr: waqad balaghat ḥudūduhā sharqan aṭrāfa ṣ-ṣīn, wagharban shawāṭiʾa l-muḥīṭi l-aṭlasiyy, wajanūban l-muḥīṭa l-hindiyy.
dialogue.en: Its borders reached the edges of China in the east, the shores of the Atlantic Ocean in the west, and the Indian Ocean in the south.
dialogue.ur: Is ki sarhadein mashriq mein China ke kinaron, maghrib mein Atlantic ke sahilon aur junoob mein Bahar-e-Hind tak pahunch gayin.

dialogue.ar: وَقَبِلَتِ الشُّعوبُ الإِسْلامَ بِرِضاها؛ فَقَدْ رَفَعَ عَنْها الظُّلْمَ، وَأَقامَ بَيْنَها العَدْل.
dialogue.tr: waqabilati sh-shuʿūbu l-islāma biriḍāhā; faqad rafaʿa ʿanhā ẓ-ẓulm, waʾaqāma baynahā l-ʿadl.
dialogue.en: The peoples accepted Islam willingly, for it lifted injustice from them and established justice among them.
dialogue.ur: Qaumon ne Islam ko khushi se qubool kiya, kyunke is ne un se zulm door kiya aur un ke darmiyan insaf qaim kiya.

dialogue.ar: وَصارَ المُسْلِمونَ عَلى اخْتِلافِ بُلْدانِهِمْ أُمَّةً واحِدَة.
dialogue.tr: waṣāra l-muslimūna ʿalā ikhtilāfi buldānihim ummatan wāḥidah.
dialogue.en: And the Muslims, despite their different countries, became one nation.
dialogue.ur: Aur Musalman apne mulkon ke ikhtilaf ke bawajood ek ummat ban gaye.

dialogue.ar: قالَ تَعالى: ﴿إِنَّ هَٰذِهِ أُمَّتُكُمْ أُمَّةً وَاحِدَةً وَأَنَا رَبُّكُمْ فَاعْبُدُونِ﴾.
dialogue.tr: qāla taʿālā: inna hādhihī ummatukum ummatan wāḥidatan wa ana rabbukum fa-ʿbudūn
dialogue.en: Allah the Most High said: 'Indeed this, your nation, is one nation, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.'
dialogue.ur: Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: 'Beshak yeh tumhari ummat ek hi ummat hai aur main tumhara rab hoon, pas meri ibadat karo.'

dialogue.ar: وَهُمْ يَخْتَلِفونَ في لُغاتِهِمْ وَأَلْوانِهِمْ وَأَعْراقِهِمْ، وَلكِنَّ الإِسْلامَ جَمَعَ قُلوبَهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: wahum yakhtalifūna fī lughātihim waʾalwānihim waʾaʿrāqihim, walkinna l-islāma jamaʿa qulūbahum.
dialogue.en: They differ in their languages, colours and races, but Islam brought their hearts together.
dialogue.ur: Woh zabanon, rangon aur nasalon mein mukhtalif hain, lekin Islam ne un ke dilon ko jora.

dialogue.ar: يَعْبُدونَ رَبّاً واحِداً، وَيَقْرَؤونَ كِتاباً واحِداً، وَيَتَّجِهونَ إِلى قِبْلَةٍ واحِدَة.
dialogue.tr: yaʿbudūna rabban wāḥidan, wayaqraʾūna kitāban wāḥidan, wayattajihūna ilā qiblatin wāḥidah.
dialogue.en: They worship one Lord, read one Book, and face one qiblah.
dialogue.ur: Woh ek Rab ki ibadat karte hain, ek kitab parhte hain, aur ek qible ki taraf rukh karte hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَتَمَيَّزُ العالَمُ الإِسْلامِيُّ بِمَوْقِعٍ مُهِمٍّ، فَهُوَ مِنْ أَهَمِّ مَناطِقِ العالَم.
dialogue.tr: wayatamayyazu l-ʿālamu l-islāmiyyu bimawqiʿin muhimm, fahuwa min ahammi manāṭiqi l-ʿālam.
dialogue.en: The Islamic world is distinguished by an important location; it is one of the most important regions in the world.
dialogue.ur: Islami duniya ek ahem muqam ki wajah se mumtaz hai; yeh duniya ke ahem tareen ilaqon mein se hai.

dialogue.ar: فَهُوَ في وَسَطِ العالَمِ تَقْريباً، يَصِلُ بَيْنَ آسيا وَإِفْريقيا وَأُوروبّا.
dialogue.tr: fahuwa fī wasaṭi l-ʿālami taqrīban, yaṣilu bayna ʾāsī waʾifrīqī waʾūrūbbā.
dialogue.en: It is almost in the middle of the world, linking Asia, Africa and Europe.
dialogue.ur: Yeh taqreeban duniya ke beech mein hai, aur Asia, Africa aur Europe ko milata hai.

dialogue.ar: وَتُطِلُّ بِلادُهُ عَلى بِحارٍ وَمُحيطاتٍ كَثيرَةٍ، مِنْها البَحْرُ الأَحْمَرُ وَبَحْرُ العَرَبِ وَالخَليجُ العَرَبِيُّ وَالمُحيطُ الهِنْدِيُّ.
dialogue.tr: watuṭillu bilāduhu ʿalā biḥārin wamuḥīṭātin kathīrah, minhā l-baḥru l-aḥmaru wabaḥru l-ʿarabi wālkhalīju l-ʿarabiyyu wālmuḥīṭu l-hindiyy.
dialogue.en: Its lands overlook many seas and oceans, among them the Red Sea, the Arabian Sea, the Arabian Gulf and the Indian Ocean.
dialogue.ur: Is ke mulk bohat se samandaron par waqe hain, jin mein Bahr-e-Ahmar, Bahr-e-Arab, Khaleej-e-Arabi aur Bahar-e-Hind shamil hain.

dialogue.ar: وَتَمْلِكُ أَرْضُهُ ثَرَواتٍ كَثيرَةً: زِراعِيَّةً وَمَعْدِنِيَّةً وَحَيَوانِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: watamliku arḍuhu tharawātin kathīrah: zirāʿiyyatan wamaʿdiniyyatan waḥayawāniyyah.
dialogue.en: Its land has many resources: agricultural, mineral and animal.
dialogue.ur: Is ki zameen mein bohat se wasail hain: zarai, maadani aur haiwani.

q.en: Where did the call of Islam begin, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Islami dawat kahan shuru hui?
q.ar: أَيْنَ بَدَأَتْ دَعْوَةُ الإِسْلامِ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: Why did many peoples enter Islam willingly?
q.ur: Bohat si qaumen khushi se Islam mein kyun dakhil huin?
q.ar: لِماذا دَخَلَتْ شُعوبٌ كَثيرَةٌ في الإِسْلامِ عَنْ رِضًا؟

options: It removed injustice and brought justice

q.en: Which is NOT one thing the Muslims share, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Musalmanon mein kaun si cheez mushtarak nahin?
q.ar: أَيُّ شَيْءٍ مِمّا يَلي لَيْسَ مِمّا يَشْتَرِكُ فيهِ المُسْلِمونَ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What is the opposite of الظُّلْم (injustice)?
q.ur: الظُّلْم ka ulta kya hai?

intro.en: A verb is either sound (صَحيح: all its letters are strong, like جَلَسَ) or weak (مُعْتَل: one of its letters is a weak letter و، ا، ي). Weak verbs have four types: مِثال (weak first letter, وَجَدَ), أَجْوَف (weak middle, قالَ), ناقِص (weak last, قَضى) and لَفيف (two weak letters, وَقى).
intro.ur: Fe'l do qism ka hota hai: sahih (jis ke sab harf mazboot hon, jaise جَلَسَ) aur mu'tall (jis mein koi harf-e-illat و، ا، ي ho). Mu'tall ki chaar qismen hain: مِثال (pehla harf illat, وَجَدَ), أَجْوَف (beech wala, قالَ), ناقِص (aakhri, قَضى) aur لَفيف (do harf illat, وَقى).
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ إِمّا صَحيحٌ جَميعُ حُروفِهِ صَحيحَةٌ مِثْلَ «جَلَسَ»، وَإِمّا مُعْتَلٌّ فيهِ حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ (و، ا، ي). وَالمُعْتَلُّ أَرْبَعَةُ أَنْواعٍ: مِثالٌ (أَوَّلُهُ حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ: وَجَدَ)، وَأَجْوَفُ (وَسَطُهُ: قالَ)، وَناقِصٌ (آخِرُهُ: قَضى)، وَلَفيفٌ (فيهِ حَرْفا عِلَّةٍ: وَقى).

q.en: Which verb is sound (صَحيح)?
q.ur: Kaun sa fe'l sahih hai?

q.en: قالَ has a weak letter in the middle. Its type is...
q.ur: قالَ mein beech mein harf-e-illat hai. Is ki qism hai...
q.ar: في «قالَ» حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ في الوَسَطِ. فَنَوْعُهُ...

q.en: وَجَدَ starts with a weak letter. Its type is...
q.ur: وَجَدَ harf-e-illat se shuru hota hai. Is ki qism hai...

q.en: قَضى has a weak letter at the end. Its type is...
q.ur: قَضى ke aakhir mein harf-e-illat hai. Is ki qism hai...
q.ar: «قَضى» فيهِ حَرْفُ عِلَّةٍ في الآخِرِ. فَنَوْعُهُ...

q.en: Which verb is لَفيف (two weak letters)?
q.ur: Kaun sa fe'l لَفيف hai (do harf-e-illat)?

title.en: Dialogue: Reasons for the weakness of Muslims
title.ur: Mukaalma: Musalmanon ki kamzori ki wajuhaat

intro.en: Mustafa and Ismail talk about why Muslims became weak and how strength can return. Notice how the dialogue names inner causes first, then outer causes, and ends with hope.
intro.ur: Mustafa aur Ismail baat karte hain ke Musalman kamzor kyun hue aur taqat kaise wapas aa sakti hai. Dhyan dein: pehle andaruni wajuhaat aati hain, phir bairooni, aur aakhir mein umeed.
intro.ar: يَتَحَدَّثُ مُصْطَفى وَإِسْماعيلُ عَنْ أَسْبابِ ضَعْفِ المُسْلِمينَ وَكَيْفَ تَعودُ القُوَّةُ. لاحِظْ أَنَّ الحِوارَ يَذْكُرُ الأَسْبابَ الدّاخِلِيَّةَ ثُمَّ الخارِجِيَّةَ وَيَنْتَهي بِالأَمَلِ.

dialogue.ar: لِماذا تَبْدو مَهْموماً يا إِسْماعيل؟
dialogue.tr: limādhā tabdū mahmūman yā ismāʿīl?
dialogue.en: Why do you look worried, Ismail?
dialogue.ur: Aap pareshan kyun lag rahe hain, Ismail?

dialogue.ar: قَرَأْتُ اليَوْمَ تَقْريراً عَنْ أَحْوالِ المُسْلِمينَ، فَحَزِنْتُ.
dialogue.tr: qaraʾtu l-yawma taqrīran ʿan aḥwāli l-muslimīn, faḥazint.
dialogue.en: I read a report today about the conditions of the Muslims, and I became sad.
dialogue.ur: Maine aaj Musalmanon ke halaat par ek report parhi aur mujhe dukh hua.

dialogue.ar: صَحيحٌ، فَالمُسْلِمونَ اليَوْمَ في حالَةِ ضَعْف.
dialogue.tr: ṣaḥīḥ, fālmuslimūna l-yawma fī ḥālati ḍaʿf.
dialogue.en: True, the Muslims today are in a state of weakness.
dialogue.ur: Sahi hai, aaj Musalman kamzori ki halat mein hain.

dialogue.ar: وَكانوا في الماضي أُمَّةً واحِدَةً قَوِيَّةً، أَمّا اليَوْمَ فَدُوَلٌ مُتَفَرِّقَة.
dialogue.tr: wakānū fī l-māḍī ummatan wāḥidatan qawiyyah, ammā l-yawma faduwalun mutafarriqah.
dialogue.en: In the past they were one strong nation, but today they are scattered states.
dialogue.ur: Maazi mein woh ek mazboot ummat the, lekin aaj mutafarriq mulk hain.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ تُفَسِّرُ أَسْبابَ هذا الضَّعْف؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa tufassiru asbāba hādhā ḍ-ḍaʿf?
dialogue.en: How do you explain the causes of this weakness?
dialogue.ur: Aap is kamzori ke asbaab ki kya tawzeeh karte hain?

dialogue.ar: أَراها نَوْعَيْنِ: أَسْباباً داخِلِيَّةً وَأَسْباباً خارِجِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: arāhā nawʿayn: asbāban dākhiliyyatan waʾasbāban khārijiyyah.
dialogue.en: I see them as two kinds: inner causes and outer causes.
dialogue.ur: Main unhein do qismon ka samajhta hoon: andaruni asbaab aur bairooni asbaab.

dialogue.ar: حَسَناً، ما الأَسْبابُ الدّاخِلِيَّةُ؟
dialogue.tr: ḥasanan, mā l-asbābu d-dākhiliyyah?
dialogue.en: Well, what are the inner causes?
dialogue.ur: Theek hai, andaruni asbaab kya hain?

dialogue.ar: أَوَّلُها أَنَّهُمْ بَعيدونَ عَنْ تَعالِيمِ الإِسْلامِ، وَثانيها الخِلافاتُ وَالمُنازَعاتُ الدّائِمَةُ، وَثالِثُها الاِنْشِغالُ بِعُلومٍ لا تَنْفَع.
dialogue.tr: awwaluhā annahum baʿīdūna ʿan taʿālīmi l-islām, wathānīhā l-khilāfātu wālmunāzaʿātu d-dāʾimah, wathālithuhā l-inshighālu biʿulūmin lā tanfaʿ.
dialogue.en: The first is that they are far from the teachings of Islam, the second is the constant disagreements and quarrels, and the third is being busy with knowledge that does not benefit.
dialogue.ur: Pehla yeh ke woh Islam ki taleemat se door hain, doosra musalsal ikhtilafat aur jhagre, aur teesra be-faida uloom mein masroof rehna.

dialogue.ar: وَماذا عَنِ الأَسْبابِ الخارِجِيَّةِ؟
dialogue.tr: wamādhā ʿani l-asbābi l-khārijiyyah?
dialogue.en: And what about the outer causes?
dialogue.ur: Aur bairooni asbaab ke bare mein kya kehte hain?

dialogue.ar: أَبْرَزُها الغَزْوُ الثَّقافِيُّ وَالاِسْتِشْراقُ وَالاِسْتِعْمار.
dialogue.tr: abrazuhā l-ghazwu th-thaqāfiyyu wālstishrāqu wālstiʿmār.
dialogue.en: The most prominent are cultural invasion, orientalism and colonialism.
dialogue.ur: Sab se numayan saqafati yalghar, istishraq aur nau-abadiyat hain.

dialogue.ar: وَكَيْفَ نَعودُ إِلى عَهْدِ القُوَّةِ؟
dialogue.tr: wakayfa naʿūdu ilā ʿahdi l-quwwah?
dialogue.en: And how do we return to the age of strength?
dialogue.ur: Aur hum quwwat ke daur mein kaise wapas ja sakte hain?

dialogue.ar: حينَ يَرْجِعُ المُسْلِمونَ إِلى دينِهِمْ وَيَتَّحِدونَ وَيَتَمَسَّكونَ بِالعِلْم.
dialogue.tr: ḥīna yarjiʿu l-muslimūna ilā dīnihim wayattaḥidūna wayatamassakūna bilʿilm.
dialogue.en: When the Muslims return to their religion, unite, and hold fast to knowledge.
dialogue.ur: Jab Musalman apne deen ki taraf lautein, mutahid ho jayein, aur ilm ko mazbooti se thamein.

dialogue.ar: وَهَلْ يُمْكِنُ ذلِكَ فِعْلاً؟
dialogue.tr: wahal yumkinu dhālik fiʿlan?
dialogue.en: And is that really possible?
dialogue.ur: Aur kya yeh waqai mumkin hai?

dialogue.ar: نَعَمْ يُمْكِنُ إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ؛ فَعَلاماتُ النَّهْضَةِ بَدَأَتْ تَظْهَر.
dialogue.tr: naʿam yumkinu in shāʾa llāh; faʿalāmātu n-nahḍati badaʾat taẓhar.
dialogue.en: Yes, it is possible, God willing; the signs of revival have begun to appear.
dialogue.ur: Ji haan, insha'Allah mumkin hai; nahzat ki nishaniyan zahir hona shuru ho gayi hain.

q.en: Which one is an inner cause of weakness mentioned in the dialogue?
q.ur: Mukaalme mein kamzori ki kaun si wajah andaruni hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سَبَبٍ داخِلِيٍّ لِلضَّعْفِ ذُكِرَ في الحِوارِ؟

q.en: Which one is an outer cause?
q.ur: Kaun si wajah bairooni hai?

q.en: How can Muslims return to the age of strength?
q.ur: Musalman taqat ke daur mein kaise lautein?
q.ar: كَيْفَ يَعودُ المُسْلِمونَ إِلى عَصْرِ القُوَّةِ؟

options: Return to their religion, unite and use knowledge
options_ar: بِالعَوْدَةِ إِلى دينِهِمْ وَالتَّوَحُّدِ وَالأَخْذِ بِالعِلْمِ

q.en: What does أَسْبابٌ داخِلِيَّةٌ mean?
q.ur: أَسْبابٌ داخِلِيَّةٌ ka matlab kya hai?

options_ar: أَسْبابٌ تَأْتي مِنْ داخِلِ المُسْلِمينَ أَنْفُسِهِمْ

intro.en: An adverb of time is a mansūb noun that tells when an action happens, such as صَباحاً (in the morning), لَيْلاً (at night), قَبْلَ (before) and بَعْدَ (after). Example: يَبْدَأُ الدَّوامُ صَباحاً, 'Work starts in the morning'.
intro.ur: ظَرْفُ الزَّمان woh mansoob ism hai jo batata hai ke kaam kab hua, jaise صَباحاً (subah), لَيْلاً (raat ko), قَبْلَ (pehle) aur بَعْدَ (baad). Misaal: يَبْدَأُ الدَّوامُ صَباحاً, yaani 'kaam subah shuru hota hai'.
intro.ar: ظَرْفُ الزَّمانِ اِسْمٌ مَنْصوبٌ يَدُلُّ عَلى وَقْتِ حُدوثِ الفِعْلِ، مِثْلَ صَباحاً وَلَيْلاً وَقَبْلَ وَبَعْدَ. مِثالٌ: يَبْدَأُ الدَّوامُ صَباحاً.

dialogue.ar: يَبْدَأُ الدَّوامُ صَباحاً.
dialogue.tr: yabdaʾu d-dawāmu ṣabāḥan.
dialogue.en: Work starts in the morning.
dialogue.ur: Kaam subah shuru hota hai.

dialogue.ar: نَزورُ جَدَّتَنا مَساءً.
dialogue.tr: nazūru jaddatanā masāʾan.
dialogue.en: We visit our grandmother in the evening.
dialogue.ur: Hum shaam ko apni dadi se milne jate hain.

dialogue.ar: تَشْتَدُّ الحَرارَةُ ظُهْراً.
dialogue.tr: tashtaddu l-ḥarāratu ẓuhran.
dialogue.en: The heat grows strong at noon.
dialogue.ur: Dopahar ko garmi shadeed ho jati hai.

dialogue.ar: نامَ الطِّفْلُ لَيْلاً.
dialogue.tr: nāma ṭ-ṭiflu laylan.
dialogue.en: The child slept at night.
dialogue.ur: Bachcha raat ko so gaya.

dialogue.ar: يَعْمَلُ الفَلّاحُ نَهاراً.
dialogue.tr: yaʿmalu l-fallāḥu nahāran.
dialogue.en: The farmer works by day.
dialogue.ur: Kisan din mein kaam karta hai.

dialogue.ar: رَجَعْتُ حينَ الغُروبِ.
dialogue.tr: rajaʿtu ḥīna l-ghurūb.
dialogue.en: I returned at sunset.
dialogue.ur: Main ghuroob ke waqt wapas aaya.

dialogue.ar: نَلْتَقي بَعْدَ الصَّلاةِ.
dialogue.tr: naltaqī baʿda ṣ-ṣalāh.
dialogue.en: We meet after the prayer.
dialogue.ur: Hum namaz ke baad milte hain.

dialogue.ar: اِغْسِلْ يَدَيْكَ قَبْلَ الطَّعامِ.
dialogue.tr: ighsil yadayka qabla ṭ-ṭaʿām.
dialogue.en: Wash your hands before the meal.
dialogue.ur: Khane se pehle apne haath dhoyein.

dialogue.ar: قَرَأْتُ ساعَةً كامِلَةً.
dialogue.tr: qaraʾtu sāʿatan kāmilah.
dialogue.en: I read for a whole hour.
dialogue.ur: Maine poora ek ghanta parha.

dialogue.ar: تَدومُ الرِّحْلَةُ يَوْماً واحِداً.
dialogue.tr: tadūmu r-riḥlatu yawman wāḥidan.
dialogue.en: The trip lasts one day.
dialogue.ur: Safar ek din tak jari rehta hai.

q.en: Which word is an adverb of time meaning 'at night'?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz 'raat ko' ke maane mein zarf-e-zaman hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ ظَرْفُ زَمانٍ يَدُلُّ عَلى وَقْتِ اللَّيْلِ؟

q.en: What does قَبْلَ mean?
q.ur: قَبْلَ ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: How do you ask 'When do you go to the university?'
q.ur: 'Aap university kab jaate hain?' arabi mein kaise poochte hain?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ نَسْأَلُ بِهِ عَنْ وَقْتِ الذَّهابِ إِلى الجامِعَةِ؟

q.en: What does ظُهْراً mean?
q.ur: ظُهْراً ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: You listen to a report about the World Islamic Council for Da'wah and Relief, then complete sentences about its work. After that you discuss with a team the reasons for the strength of Muslims in the past and their weakness today.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein Islami tanzeem 'al-Majlis al-Islami al-Alami lil-Dawah wal-Ighasa' ke baare mein khabar suni jati hai aur jumle mukammal kiye jate hain. Phir apni team ke saath bahas karni hai ke maazi mein Musalmanon ki taqat aur aaj ki kamzori ki wajuhaat kya hain.
intro.ar: تَسْتَمِعُ إِلى تَقْريرٍ عَنِ المَجْلِسِ العالَمِيِّ لِلدَّعْوَةِ وَالإِغاثَةِ، ثُمَّ تُكْمِلُ جُمَلاً عَنْ عَمَلِهِ. بَعْدَ ذلِكَ تُناقِشُ مَعَ فَريقٍ أَسْبابَ قُوَّةِ المُسْلِمينَ قَديماً وَضَعْفِهِمْ اليَوْمَ.

dialogue.ar: اُذْكُرِ اسْمَ مَنْ يَتَوَلّى رِئاسَةَ هذا المَجْلِسِ الَّذي يَعْمَلُ في الدَّعْوَةِ وَالإِغاثَةِ: ...
dialogue.tr: udhkuri isma man yatawallā riʾāsata hādhā l-majlisi illadhī yaʿmalu fī d-daʿwati wālʾighāthah:...
dialogue.en: Say the name of the one who heads this council that works in da'wah and relief: ...
dialogue.ur: Dawat aur imdad mein kaam karne wali is majlis ki sarbarahi karne wale ka naam batayein: ...

dialogue.ar: يَصِلُ عَوْنُ المَجْلِسِ إِلى ...
dialogue.tr: yaṣilu ʿawnu l-majlisi ilā...
dialogue.en: The council's aid reaches ...
dialogue.ur: Majlis ki imdad pahunchti hai ...

dialogue.ar: هَدَفُ المُنَظَّماتِ الإِسْلامِيَّةِ هُوَ ...
dialogue.tr: hadafu l-munaẓẓamāti l-islāmiyyati huw...
dialogue.en: The aim of Islamic organisations is ...
dialogue.ur: Islami tanzeemon ka maqsad hai ...

dialogue.ar: المُسْلِمونَ وَغَيْرُهُمْ جُزْءٌ مِنَ ...
dialogue.tr: al-muslimūna waghayruhum juzʾun min...
dialogue.en: Muslims and others are a part of ...
dialogue.ur: Musalman aur doosre log iska hissa hain ...

dialogue.ar: ناقِشْ مَعَ فَريقِكَ: لِماذا كانَ المُسْلِمونَ أَقْوِياءَ في الماضي؟
dialogue.tr: nāqish maʿa farīqik: limādhā kāna l-muslimūna aqwīʾa fī l-māḍī?
dialogue.en: Discuss with your team: why were the Muslims strong in the past?
dialogue.ur: Apni team ke saath bahas karein: maazi mein Musalman mazboot kyun the?

dialogue.ar: ناقِشْ مَعَ فَريقِكَ: لِماذا هُمْ ضِعافٌ في هذا العَصْرِ؟
dialogue.tr: nāqish maʿa farīqik: limādhā hum ḍiʿāfun fī hādhā l-ʿaṣr?
dialogue.en: Discuss with your team: why are they weak in this age?
dialogue.ur: Apni team ke saath bahas karein: is daur mein woh kamzor kyun hain?

q.en: What does الإِغاثَة mean?
q.ur: الإِغاثَة ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: What does أَهْداف mean?
q.ur: أَهْداف ka matlab kya hai?

q.en: Which word means 'the past'?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz 'maazi' ka matlab rakhta hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَدُلُّ عَلى الزَّمَنِ الَّذي مَضى؟

q.en: What does فَريق mean?
q.ur: فَريق ka matlab kya hai?

intro.en: A short reading about two Islamic countries: Saudi Arabia in Asia and Nigeria in Africa. You will learn their capitals, currencies and languages.
intro.ur: Do Islami mulkon ke baare mein mukhtasar tehreer: Asia mein Saudi Arabia aur Africa mein Nigeria. Un ke daar-ul-hukoomat, currency aur zabanon ke baare mein jaanenge.
intro.ar: قِراءَةٌ قَصيرَةٌ عَنْ دَوْلَتَيْنِ إِسْلامِيَّتَيْنِ: المَمْلَكَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ السُّعودِيَّةِ في آسيا وَنيجيريا في إِفْريقيا. سَتَتَعَرَّفُ إِلى عاصِمَتَيْهِما وَعُمْلَتَيْهِما وَلُغَتَيْهِما.

dialogue.ar: في العالَمِ دُوَلٌ إِسْلامِيَّةٌ كَثيرَةٌ، وَسَنَتَعَرَّفُ هُنا إِلى دَوْلَتَيْنِ مِنْها.
dialogue.tr: fī l-ʿālami duwalun islāmiyyatun kathīrah, wasanataʿarrafu hunā ilā dawlatayni minhā.
dialogue.en: There are many Islamic countries in the world, and here we will get to know two of them.
dialogue.ur: Duniya mein bohat se Islami mulk hain, aur yahan hum un mein se do se waqif honge.

dialogue.ar: الأولى في قارَّةِ آسيا وَهِيَ السُّعودِيَّةُ، وَالثّانِيَةُ في قارَّةِ إِفْريقيا وَهِيَ نيجيريا.
dialogue.tr: al-ūlā fī qārrati ʾāsī wahiya s-suʿūdiyyah, wālththāniyatu fī qārrati ifrīqī wahiya nījīrī.
dialogue.en: The first is in Asia and it is Saudi Arabia, and the second is in Africa and it is Nigeria.
dialogue.ur: Pehla Asia mein hai aur woh Saudi Arabia hai, aur doosra Africa mein hai aur woh Nigeria hai.

dialogue.ar: المَمْلَكَةُ العَرَبِيَّةُ السُّعودِيَّةُ دَوْلَةٌ في غَرْبِ آسيا، وَتَضُمُّ المَدينَتَيْنِ المُقَدَّسَتَيْنِ: مَكَّةَ المُكَرَّمَةَ وَفيها المَسْجِدُ الحَرامُ، وَالمَدينَةَ المُنَوَّرَةَ وَفيها مَسْجِدُ الرَّسولِ ﷺ.
dialogue.tr: al-mamlakatu l-ʿarabiyyatu s-suʿūdiyyatu dawlatun fī gharbi ʾāsī, wataḍummu l-madīnatayni l-muqaddasatayn: makkata l-mukarramata wafīhā l-masjidu l-ḥarām, wālmadīnata l-munawwarata wafīhā masjidu r-rasūli ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam.
dialogue.en: The Kingdom of Saudi Arabia is a country in western Asia, and it contains the two holy cities: Makkah, in which is the Sacred Mosque, and Madinah, in which is the Mosque of the Messenger ﷺ.
dialogue.ur: Saudi Arabia mashriqi Asia ka ek mulk hai, aur is mein do muqaddas shehar hain: Makkah Mukarramah jis mein Masjid-e-Haram hai, aur Madinah Munawwarah jis mein Rasool ﷺ ki masjid hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَقْصِدُهُما المُسْلِمونَ مِنْ شَتّى أَنْحاءِ الأَرْضِ لِلحَجِّ وَالعُمْرَةِ وَالزِّيارَةِ وَالصَّلاة.
dialogue.tr: wayaqṣiduhumā l-muslimūna min shattā anḥāʾi l-arḍi lilḥajji wālʿumrati wālzzīrati wālṣṣalāh.
dialogue.en: Muslims head to them from all corners of the earth for Hajj, Umrah, visiting and prayer.
dialogue.ur: Musalman zameen ke har kone se hajj, umrah, ziyarat aur namaz ke liye wahan jate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَالعاصِمَةُ هِيَ الرِّياضُ، وَهِيَ مَدينَةٌ كَبيرَةٌ حَديثَةٌ فيها مَبانٍ عالِيَة.
dialogue.tr: wālʿāṣimatu hiya r-rīḍ, wahiya madīnatun kabīratun ḥadīthatun fīhā mabānin ʿāliyah.
dialogue.en: The capital is Riyadh, a large modern city with tall buildings.
dialogue.ur: Daar-ul-hukoomat Riyadh hai, jo ek bara jadeed shehar hai jis mein unchi imaratein hain.

dialogue.ar: لُغَةُ الحَديثِ هُناكَ هِيَ العَرَبِيَّةُ، وَأَهْلُها كُلُّهُمْ مُسْلِمونَ، وَالرِّيالُ هُوَ عُمْلَتُها، وَتَزْخَرُ أَرْضُها بِالنِّفْطِ فَهِيَ دَوْلَةٌ غَنِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: lughatu l-ḥadīthi hunāka hiya l-ʿarabiyyah, waʾahluhā kulluhum muslimūn, wālrrīlu huwa ʿumlatuhā, watazkharu arḍuhā bilnnifṭi fahiya dawlatun ghaniyyah.
dialogue.en: The spoken language there is Arabic, its people are all Muslims, the riyal is its currency, and its land is full of oil, so it is a rich country.
dialogue.ur: Wahan bolchaal ki zaban Arabi hai, wahan ke log sab Musalman hain, riyal un ki currency hai, aur un ki zameen tel se bhari hai, is liye woh ek ameer mulk hai.

dialogue.ar: وَنيجيريا بَلَدٌ إِسْلامِيٌّ آخَرُ في الجُزْءِ الغَرْبِيِّ مِنْ قارَّةِ إِفْريقيا، وَعاصِمَتُهُ أَبوجا.
dialogue.tr: wanījīrī baladun islāmiyyun ʾākharu fī l-juzʾi l-gharbiyyi min qārrati ifrīqī, waʿāṣimatuhu abūjā.
dialogue.en: Nigeria is another Islamic country in the western part of the continent of Africa, and its capital is Abuja.
dialogue.ur: Nigeria Africa ke maghribi hisse mein ek aur Islami mulk hai, aur Abuja is ka daar-ul-hukoomat hai.

dialogue.ar: وَأَغْلَبُ أَهْلِها يَعيشونَ مِنْ حِرْفَةِ الزِّراعَةِ وَحِرْفَةِ الرَّعْيِ وَحِرْفَةِ صَيْدِ الأَسْماك.
dialogue.tr: waʾaghlabu ahlihā yaʿīshūna min ḥirfati z-zirāʿati waḥirfati r-raʿyi waḥirfati ṣaydi l-asmāk.
dialogue.en: Most of its people live from the trade of farming, the trade of herding and the trade of fishing.
dialogue.ur: Wahan ke aksar log kheti, gallabani aur machhli ke shikar ke pesho se rozi kamate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَتُسْتَعْمَلُ الإِنْجليزِيَّةُ لُغَةً رَسْمِيَّةً، وَعُمْلَةُ الدَّوْلَةِ هِيَ النّايْرا، وَمِنَ اللُّغاتِ المَحَلِّيَّةِ الهَوْسا وَاليوروبا وَالإيبو.
dialogue.tr: watustaʿmalu l-injlīziyyatu lughatan rasmiyyah, waʿumlatu d-dawlati hiya n-nāyrā, wamina l-lughāti l-maḥalliyyati l-hawsā wālīwrūbā wālʾībū.
dialogue.en: English is used as the official language, the country's currency is the naira, and among the local languages are Hausa, Yoruba and Igbo.
dialogue.ur: Sarkari zaban angrezi hai, mulk ki currency naira hai, aur muqami zabanon mein Hausa, Yoruba aur Igbo shamil hain.

dialogue.ar: وَكَثيرٌ مِنْ سُكّانِها يُحِبّونَ تَعَلُّمَ اللُّغَةِ العَرَبِيَّة.
dialogue.tr: wakathīrun min sukkānihā yuḥibbūna taʿalluma l-lughati l-ʿarabiyyah.
dialogue.en: Many of its inhabitants love learning the Arabic language.
dialogue.ur: Is ke bohat se baashinde Arabi zaban seekhna pasand karte hain.

q.en: What is the capital of Saudi Arabia, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Saudi Arabia ka daar-ul-hukoomat kya hai?
q.ar: ما عاصِمَةُ المَمْلَكَةِ العَرَبِيَّةِ السُّعودِيَّةِ حَسَبَ النَّصِّ؟

q.en: What is the capital of Nigeria, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq Nigeria ka daar-ul-hukoomat kya hai?

q.en: What is the official language of Nigeria?
q.ur: Nigeria ki sarkari zabaan kaun si hai?

q.en: What is the currency of Nigeria?
q.ur: Nigeria ki currency kya hai?

q.en: Why do Muslims come to Makkah and Madinah?
q.ur: Musalman Makkah aur Madinah kyun aate hain?
q.ar: لِماذا يَأْتي المُسْلِمونَ إِلى مَكَّةَ وَالمَدينَةِ؟

options: For Hajj, Umrah, visits and prayer

intro.en: The five verbs are present-tense verbs that end with the dual alif, the plural wāw or the feminine-you yā: يَفْعَلان، تَفْعَلان، يَفْعَلون، تَفْعَلون، تَفْعَلين. They are raised by keeping the nūn (تَدْرُسانِ), and put in nasb and jazm by dropping it (لَنْ تَدْرُسا، لَمْ تَدْرُسا).
intro.ur: Af'al-e-Khamsah woh mudaare' hain jin ke aakhir mein alif-e-tasniya, waw-e-jama'at ya ya-e-mukhatabah ho: يَفْعَلان، تَفْعَلان، يَفْعَلون، تَفْعَلون، تَفْعَلين. Raf' mein noon barqarar rehta hai (تَدْرُسانِ), aur nasb aur jazm mein noon gir jata hai (لَنْ تَدْرُسا، لَمْ تَدْرُسا).
intro.ar: الأَفْعالُ الخَمْسَةُ أَفْعالٌ مُضارِعَةٌ تَنْتَهي بِأَلِفِ الاِثْنَيْنِ أَوْ واوِ الجَماعَةِ أَوْ ياءِ المُخاطَبَةِ: يَفْعَلانِ، تَفْعَلانِ، يَفْعَلونَ، تَفْعَلونَ، تَفْعَلينَ. تُرْفَعُ بِثُبوتِ النّونِ (تَدْرُسانِ)، وَتُنْصَبُ وَتُجْزَمُ بِحَذْفِها (لَنْ تَدْرُسا، لَمْ تَدْرُسا).

dialogue.ar: أَنْتُما تَكْتُبانِ الدَّرْسَ.
dialogue.tr: antumā taktubāni d-dars.
dialogue.en: You two write the lesson.
dialogue.ur: Aap dono sabaq likhte hain.

dialogue.ar: هُما يَسْمَعانِ الخَبَرَ.
dialogue.tr: humā yasmaʿāni l-khabar.
dialogue.en: They two hear the news.
dialogue.ur: Woh dono khabar sunte hain.

dialogue.ar: هُمْ يَكْتُبونَ الرِّسالَةَ.
dialogue.tr: hum yaktubūna r-risālah.
dialogue.en: They write the letter.
dialogue.ur: Woh khat likhte hain.

dialogue.ar: أَنْتُمْ تَأْكُلونَ الغَداءَ.
dialogue.tr: antum taʾkulūna l-ghadāʾ.
dialogue.en: You (plural) eat lunch.
dialogue.ur: Aap log dopahar ka khana khate hain.

dialogue.ar: أَنْتِ تَذْهَبينَ إِلى المَدْرَسَةِ.
dialogue.tr: anti tadhhabīna ilā l-madrasah.
dialogue.en: You (female) go to school.
dialogue.ur: Aap school jati hain.

dialogue.ar: أَنْتُما لَنْ تَتَغَيَّبا غَداً.
dialogue.tr: antumā lan tataghayyabā ghadan.
dialogue.en: You two will not be absent tomorrow.
dialogue.ur: Aap dono kal ghair-hazir nahin honge.

dialogue.ar: هُمْ لَنْ يَنْجَحوا بِالكَسَلِ.
dialogue.tr: hum lan yanjaḥū bilkasal.
dialogue.en: They will not succeed through laziness.
dialogue.ur: Woh susti se kamyab nahin honge.

dialogue.ar: أَنْتُما لَمْ تُصَلِّيا بَعْدُ.
dialogue.tr: antumā lam tuṣallī baʿd.
dialogue.en: You two have not prayed yet.
dialogue.ur: Aap dono ne abhi tak namaz nahin parhi.

dialogue.ar: أَنْتِ لَمْ تُسافِري هذا العامَ.
dialogue.tr: anti lam tusāfirī hādhā l-ʿām.
dialogue.en: You (female) did not travel this year.
dialogue.ur: Aap ne is saal safar nahin kiya.

dialogue.ar: العُمّالُ يَذْهَبونَ إِلى المَصْنَعِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿummālu yadhhabūna ilā l-maṣnaʿ.
dialogue.en: The workers go to the factory.
dialogue.ur: Mazdoor factory jate hain.

dialogue.ar: الأَخَوانِ يَسْمَعانِ كَلامَ والِدِهِما.
dialogue.tr: al-akhawāni yasmaʿāni kalāma wālidihimā.
dialogue.en: The two brothers listen to their father's words.
dialogue.ur: Dono bhai apne walid ki baat sunte hain.

dialogue.ar: المُسْلِمونَ يُحِبّونَ السَّلامَ.
dialogue.tr: al-muslimūna yuḥibbūna s-salām.
dialogue.en: The Muslims love peace.
dialogue.ur: Musalman amn se muhabbat karte hain.

q.en: Which verb is one of the five verbs?
q.ur: Kaun sa fe'l af'al-e-khamsah mein se hai?

q.en: What happens to the nūn after لَنْ or لَمْ?
q.ur: لَنْ ya لَمْ ke baad noon ka kya hota hai?

q.en: Choose the correct form: هُمْ لَمْ ___
q.ur: Sahi surat chunein: هُمْ لَمْ ___

q.en: Which one is for a woman (you, female)?
q.ur: Kaun sa aurat ke liye hai (aap, muannas)?

intro.en: Now you practise writing: a short essay on the Islamic world using the second reading, a summary of the last text, an essay on the weakness of Muslims in modern times, and an essay about your own country.
intro.ur: Ab likhne ki mashq hai: Islami duniya par mazmoon, aakhri matn ka khulasa, maujooda daur mein Musalmanon ki kamzori par mazmoon, aur apne mulk ke baare mein mazmoon.
intro.ar: الآنَ تَتَدَرَّبُ عَلى الكِتابَةِ: مَوْضوعٌ قَصيرٌ عَنِ العالَمِ الإِسْلامِيِّ مُسْتَعيناً بِالقِراءَةِ الثّانِيَةِ، وَتَلْخيصٌ لِلنَّصِّ الأَخيرِ، وَمَوْضوعٌ عَنْ ضَعْفِ المُسْلِمينَ في العَصْرِ الحَديثِ، وَآخَرُ عَنْ بَلَدِكَ.

dialogue.ar: اُكْتُبْ نَصّاً مِنْ فِقْرَةٍ واحِدَةٍ عُنْوانُهُ: ما يَتَمَيَّزُ بِهِ العالَمُ الإِسْلامِيُّ.
dialogue.tr: uktub naṣṣan min fiqratin wāḥidatin ʿunwānuh: mā yatamayyazu bihi l-ʿālamu l-islāmiyy.
dialogue.en: Write a one-paragraph text whose title is: What distinguishes the Islamic world.
dialogue.ur: Ek paragraph likhein jis ka unwan ho: Islami duniya ko kya mumtaz banata hai.

dialogue.ur: Do paragraphon ka mazmoon likhein: in dinon Musalman kamzor kyun ho gaye?

dialogue.tr: uktub ʿan waṭanik: mawqiʿuh, misāḥatuh, sukkānuh, ʿāṣimatuh, lughatuh, ʿumlatuh, iqtiṣāduh, wataʿlīmuh.

title.en: Calligraphy and spelling: the extra alif

intro.en: First, copy a line of poetry in the Ruq'ah script. Then learn about the extra alif: it is written but not pronounced, for example after the plural wāw in a verb (اتَّفَقوا) and after a tanween-nasb noun (مُحَمَّداً).
intro.ur: Pehle Ruq'ah khat mein ek sher naqal karein. Phir ziyadat-e-alif ka qaida: yeh alif likha jata hai magar parha nahin jata, jaise fe'l mein waw-e-jama'at ke baad (اتَّفَقوا) aur tanween-e-nasb wale ism ke baad (مُحَمَّداً).
intro.ar: اِنْسَخْ أَوَّلاً بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ بِخَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ. ثُمَّ تَعَلَّمِ الأَلِفَ الزّائِدَةَ: تُكْتَبُ وَلا تُنْطَقُ، مِثْلَ الأَلِفِ بَعْدَ واوِ الجَماعَةِ في «اِتَّفَقوا» وَبَعْدَ تَنْوينِ النَّصْبِ في «مُحَمَّداً».

dialogue.ar: وَسِعْتُ كِتابَ اللهِ لَفْظاً وَغايَةً، وَما ضِقْتُ عَنْ آيٍ بِهِ وَعِظاتِ.
dialogue.tr: wasiʿtu kitāba llāhi lafẓan wa ghāyah, wa mā ḍiqtu ʿan āyin bihī wa ʿiẓāt
dialogue.en: I have encompassed the Book of Allah in wording and purpose, and I was never too narrow for its verses and admonitions.
dialogue.ur: Main ne Kitabullah ko alfaz aur maqsad dono mein samo liya, aur us ki ayaat aur nasihaton se kabhi tang nahin hua.

dialogue.ar: التُّجّارُ اتَّفَقوا عَلى السِّعْرِ وَلَمْ يَخْتَلِفوا، وَلَنْ يَخْتَلِفوا بَعْدَ اليَوْم.
dialogue.tr: at-tujjāru ittafaqū ʿalā s-siʿri walam yakhtalifū, walan yakhtalifū baʿda l-yawm.
dialogue.en: The merchants agreed on the price and did not differ, and will not differ after today.
dialogue.ur: Tajiron ne qeemat par ittifaq kiya aur ikhtilaf nahin kiya, aur aaj ke baad bhi ikhtilaf nahin karenge.

dialogue.ar: نُحِبُّ نَبِيَّنا مُحَمَّداً ﷺ.
dialogue.tr: nuḥibbu nabiyyanā muḥammadan ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam.
dialogue.en: We love our Prophet Muhammad ﷺ.
dialogue.ur: Hum apne Nabi Muhammad ﷺ se muhabbat karte hain.

dialogue.ar: لَمَحْنا جَمَلاً ضَخْماً قُرْبَ الحَديقَة.
dialogue.tr: lamaḥnā jamalan ḍakhman qurba l-ḥadīqah.
dialogue.en: We spotted a huge camel near the garden.
dialogue.ur: Hum ne bagh ke qareeb ek bahut bara oont dekha.

dialogue.ar: إِنَّ العُلَماءَ يَجْتَهِدونَ في طَلَبِ العِلْمِ، فَاحْفَظوا لَهُمْ حَقَّهُمْ.
dialogue.tr: inna l-ʿulamāʾa yajtahidūna fī ṭalabi l-ʿilm, fāḥfaẓū lahum ḥaqqahum.
dialogue.en: The scholars strive in seeking knowledge, so preserve their due.
dialogue.ur: Ulama ilm ki talash mein mehnat karte hain, is liye un ka haq yaad rakhein.

dialogue.ar: الحِلْمُ زينَةُ الإِنْسانِ، وَالجَهْلُ يَجْلِبُ النَّدَمَ، فَاحْرِصوا عَلى الحِلْمِ وَاتْرُكوا الجَهْل.
dialogue.tr: al-ḥilmu zīnatu l-insān, wāljahlu yajlibu n-nadam, fāḥriṣū ʿalā l-ḥilmi wātrukū l-jahl.
dialogue.en: Forbearance is a person's adornment and ignorance brings regret, so hold on to forbearance and leave ignorance.
dialogue.ur: Burdbari insan ki zeenat hai aur jahalat pachhtawa laati hai, is liye burdbari ko thaamein aur jahalat ko chhor dein.
